biography.value:
水巨靈Marid

    來自水元素位面的水巨靈是最奇妙的巨靈。雖然所有巨靈都擁有強大的力量，但即使最低階的水巨靈也認爲自己明顯優於輕浮的氣巨靈djinn、躲在地裏的土巨靈dao和易怒的火巨靈efreet。
    身材龐大長着一副魚相的水巨靈看起來有點怪，特別是它們還喜歡穿着精緻的背心和五顏六色的褲子。它們說話的聲音像海風一樣優柔，又或像風暴巨浪拍向峭壁一樣渾厚。它們在飛行會將下半身變成一團飛沫的水柱。

    以水稱霸Water Lords。水是水巨靈的本質元素，它們也能夠以任何方式操縱水。水巨靈可以在水面上行走，在水下自然呼吸。可以在空氣中創造水，或進一步塑形成密雲或薄霧。甚至可以將自己化身爲霧，或是以水作爲武器打擊敵人。

    水巨靈之家Marid Homes。物質位面裏很少能見到水巨靈。它們棲息在水元素平面裏雄偉壯觀的珊瑚堡壘中。這些城堡漂浮在位面的最深處，裏面有充滿空氣的華麗房間供奴隸和訪客們使用。
    水巨靈不需要奴隸來擔當太多的工作，只是單純想要獲得它們的所有權。水巨靈會外出尋獲有一技之長的奴隸，甚至會綁架那些凡人藝術家、藝人或說書人到自己的宮殿中。

    自負的主教Egotistical Hierarchs。所有水巨靈聲稱自己有着貴族的頭銜，而且這個種族裏還充斥着諸多沙阿shahs（伊朗國王稱號）、蘇丹sultan（伊斯蘭國王稱號）、穆夫提muftis（伊斯蘭教教法權威）和赫迪夫khedives（埃及總督）。但大多數這些頭銜都只是自命不凡的水巨靈單純的顯擺。
    水巨靈將所有人（包括其他巨靈）定爲不同階層的下級人士，包括底層如貧窮表兄妹到瑣碎的小麻煩。它們對氣巨靈djinn表現容忍，對土巨靈dao表現厭惡，而對火巨靈efreet表示鄙視。
    類人生物是水巨靈必須容忍的生物中最低階的一類，不過它們還是偶爾會與一些強大的法術或傑出的領導者進行近乎平等的交往。由於法師們已經可以成功將水巨靈囚禁於古老的貝殼、燒瓶和酒壺中，水巨靈的這種信任有時會最終導致錯誤的結果。賄賂和奉承是應付水巨靈最好的方法，而選擇諂媚的凡人才是真正清楚自己的身份。

    古怪的說書人Whimsical Storyteller。水巨靈是冠軍級的說書人，它們最喜歡那些能體現水巨靈非凡技藝（尤其是作爲演說者）的傳奇故事。作爲極富幻想的巨靈，它們時常說謊而且還極之有創作感。它們並不是惡意欺騙，但其修飾潤色一定要符合自己的幻象。水巨靈認爲低等存在打斷自己族人的故事等同犯罪，而如此冒犯一名水巨靈必然會激起對方的盛怒。

“水巨靈像水一樣從瓶中倒出，說道：‘聽從您的願望。’半身人喜出望外並許願成爲不朽。於是水巨靈將他變形爲一條魚，並滑稽地重摔在地上，就這樣一直到最後，最終時效結束之日。這是一個從古老時代流傳下來的警示寓言，所以我覺得半身人確實實現了自己的願望。”

——凱斯托?亮眼Kesto Brighteyes，
印記城Sigil書店“掀開的面紗Parted Veil”的老闆

巨靈Genies

    “歡迎來到內層位面的瑰寶——大陰暗地宮Great Dismal Delve。現在，你已經作爲奴隸從屬於仁慈而強大的哈頓?藏法拉?阿伊爾?金?扎拉因 Khatun Zafara al’Yil jin Zarain，她是地幔深淵的女王Queen of the Mantler Depths，是鑽石大教堂的主教Pontiff of the Diamond Cathedral，孔雀石權杖的保護者Protector of the Malachite Scepter，如此這般。”

——石像鬼管家的常規問候語

巨靈是來自故事和傳奇裏的罕見元素生物。除少數能在物質位面中見到的巨靈外，其他大多數都生活在元素位面中，並從其宏大的宮殿發號施令，統領着其下的奴隸崇拜者。
    巨靈們聰穎而強大，並因自身的偉大而自豪。它們高傲而放縱，植跟在它們心中的權力意識，源於它們無人能及的知識，而只有衆神和其他的巨靈纔夠格挑戰這種力量。

    元素生物Creatures of the Elements。巨靈誕生於智慧生命的靈魂與元素位面的原初物質相融合。只有在很罕見的情況下，這種注入到元素的靈魂纔會凝聚成顯化的形態併成爲一個巨靈。
    巨靈通常與構成自己的靈魂沒有任何聯繫。以此而來的生命力只是構築其本身的部件，以及形成巨靈的形態和性別外貌，還有偶爾從中繼承的一兩項突出個人特點。巨靈雖然長着類人生物的形態，事實上卻是有着物理形態的元素精魄。它們不會和其他巨靈結成配偶，也不會繁衍巨靈後代，因此所有的新生巨靈都來自精魄能量與元素之力的融合。某些受自身凡人靈魂影響較大的巨靈也許會選擇與凡人繁衍後代，只是這種孩子依然非常罕見。
    巨靈死亡時不留遺體，除了身上着裝或攜帶的東西外，就只會殘留一點與其本質相應的元素：一堆塵土，一陣風，一團煙火，或一股水與泡沫。

    爲主爲奴Rule or Be Ruled。手下成羣的凡人奴隸代表着巨靈的力量和高度自負。一百人的討好聲是巨靈耳邊的美樂，而兩百個腳下的奴隸便是身爲主子的明證。巨靈將奴隸看作活着的財產，而一個沒有財產的巨靈在同類中也就毫無地位。着最終也導致許多巨靈都珍視自己的奴隸，甚至將它們當作名義上的家族成員。邪惡巨靈會隨心所欲的威脅和虐待自己的奴隸，但也會注意不會弄得對方失去利用價值。
    雖然都喜愛奴役他人，但大多數巨靈並不樂意爲別人服務。巨靈只有被收買或被以魔法強迫時，纔會服從別人的意志。所有巨靈都掌握着自己本質元素的力量，其中極少數的個體還擁有實現願望的能力。也正因此，凡人法師經常會設法將巨靈束縛起來爲自己服務。

    放縱貴族Decadent Nobility。巨靈貴族是其族類中的稀有羣體。它們習慣了隨心所欲，並學會了用自己能力去換取想要的東西。它們沉溺於此並變得放縱不羈，而超越現實的力量也使它們變得愈加傲慢自大。它們巨大的宮殿裏也因此而充滿了難以想象的奇觀和感官刺激。
    每時每刻方方面面都佔盡優越性的巨靈貴族也滋生了其他巨靈的羨慕與嫉妒。普通巨靈知道反抗一個隨時可以改變現實的生物有多不明智，因此只能選擇尊重巨靈貴族的影響力。只是並不是每個巨靈都願意受制於巨靈貴族，它們有時會奮起挑戰這些巨靈貴族的意志，並承擔起這樣做的後果。

    崇拜之力The Power of Worship。精靈們承認衆神是強大的實體，卻不願對其表示奉承或崇拜。它們覺得獻身宗教的阿諛奉承和撒嬌諂媚非常累人——除非是自己作爲受奴隸崇拜討好的對象。
    它們坐擁無與倫比的力量，宏偉壯麗的住所，以及數量龐大的奴隸羣。有時甚至讓它們足以欺騙自己，覺得自己已經如神靈般強大。有些個體甚至要讓其他領域的凡人（甚至整個大陸或整個世界的凡人）拜倒在自己身下。

變體：巨靈之力Variant: Genie Powers

    巨靈擁有各種各樣的魔法能力，包括各種法術。其中某些個體擁有更強大的力量，甚至可以改變自己外表或現實本質。

  僞裝Disguises。某些巨靈可以將自己掩蓋在幻覺中，使自己的身形看起來就像其他生物一樣。這些巨靈天生可以隨意的施展法術易容術disguise self，且比通常情況下的該法術擁有更長的法術持續時間。更強大的巨靈可以每日施展一到三次完全變形術true polymorph，甚至可能比通常情況下的該法術擁有更長的法術持續時間。這些巨靈只能改變自己的外形，但仍有極少數的個體能將該法術施展到其他生物或物件身上。

  許願Wishes。巨靈授予願望的力量在凡人中已經成爲傳奇。只有最強大的巨靈（比如巨靈貴族中的某些個體）才能做到這點。擁有這種力量的特殊巨靈們可以給一個非巨靈生物授予一個到三個願望。當巨靈給出了所有自己保有的願望後，一段時間內（通常是1年）將無法再授予願望。宇宙法則規定，一個特定的生物在其自身存在的年月裏，只有一次機會去接受同一名巨靈授予其許願上限數量的願望。
    想要得到願望的生物必須身處巨靈身邊60尺內，並向其陳述自己想要的效應。然後，該巨靈再代表該生物施展祈願術wish來實現效應。根據巨靈本性的不同，它可能會試圖曲解陳述願望時的貧乏措辭來扭曲願望的意圖。這種曲解往往都是巨靈爲自己的利益而故意設計的詭計。

Hailing from the Elemental Plane of Water, the marids are the most wondrous of genie-kind. Although all genies wield great power, even the lowliest marid sees itself as clearly superior to the flighty djinn, the ground-hugging dao, and the fuming efreet. Large and piscine, marids are a strange sight to behold, particularly when clad in the finely stitched vests and colorful pantaloons they favor. They speak in voices as soft as the sea breeze or as sonorous as storm waves breaking against a rocky cliff. In flight, their lower bodies transform into columns of foamy water.

Water Lords. Water is a marid's native element, and the genie can manipulate water in virtually any way it desires. A marid can walk on water and breathe naturally beneath its surface. It can create water or shape clouds of fog and mist from the vapor in the air. It can even transform itself into mist, or use water as a weapon to bludgeon its foes.

Marid Homes. Marids are rare on the Material Plane. They inhabit mighty and majestic coral fortresses located in the Elemental Plane of Water. These citadels float in the depths of the plane and contain opulent, air-filled chambers where slaves and guests reside.

A marid doesn't expect much from its slaves, simply wanting to have them for the status of ownership. Marids go out of their way to obtain skilled slaves, and aren't above kidnapping mortal artists, entertainers, or storytellers for use in their courts.

Egotistical Hierarchs. All marids claim a title of nobility, and the race is awash in shahs, sultans, muftis, and khedives. Most of these titles are mere pretense on the part of the self-important marids.

Marids treat all others-including other genies-as inferiors of various grades, ranging from poor cousins to petty annoyances. They tolerate djinn, dislike dao, and despise efreet.

Humanoids are among the lowest of the creatures that marids must tolerate, although they sometimes deal with powerful wizards and exceptional leaders on an almost-equal footing. Doing so has sometimes proven to be a mistake, since wizards have managed to imprison marids in conch shells, flasks, and decanters over the ages. Bribery and flattery are the best means of dealing with marids, to which an obsequious mortal is a creature that knows its place.

Whimsical Storytellers. Marids are champion tale-tellers, whose favorite legends emphasize the prowess of marids in general and of the speaker in particular. Fanciful genies, they lie often and creatively. They aren't always malicious in their deception, but embellishments suit their fancy. Marids consider it a crime for a lesser being to interrupt one of their tales, and offending a marid is a sure way to invoke its wrath.

“The marid poured out of the flask like water and said, 'Your wish is my command.' The halfling, overjoyed, wished for immortality, so the marid polymorphed him into a fish that flopped around humorously until, finally, it expired. It's a cautionary tale that has survived through the ages, so I suppose the halfling got his wish.”

— Kesto Brighteyes, Gnome Proprietor of the Parted Veil, a bookshop in Sigil

Variant: Genie Powers[–]

Genies have a variety of magical capabilities, including spells. A few have even greater powers that allow them to alter their appearance or the nature of reality.

Disguises. Some genies can veil themselves in illusion to pass as other similarly shaped creatures. Such genies can innately cast the disguise self spell at will, often with a longer duration than is normal for that spell. Mightier genies can cast the true polymorph spell one to three times per day, possibly with a longer duration than normal. Such genies can change only their own shape, but a rare few can use the spell on other creatures and objects as well.

Wishes. The genie power to grant wishes is legendary among mortals. Only the most potent genies, such as those among the nobility, can do so. A particular genie that has this power can grant one to three wishes to a creature that isn't a genie. Once a genie has granted its limit of wishes, it can't grant wishes again for some amount of time (usually 1 year), and cosmic law dictates that the same genie can expend its limit of wishes on a specific creature only once in that creature's existence.

To be granted a wish, a creature within 60 feet of the genie states a desired effect to it. The genie can then cast the wish spell on the creature's behalf to bring about the effect. Depending on the genie's nature, the genie might try to pervert the intent of the wish by exploiting the wish's poor wording. The perversion of the wording is usually crafted to be to the genie's benefit.

水巨靈發動兩次三叉戟攻擊。

The marid makes two trident attacks.

近戰或遠程武器攻擊：命中+10，觸及5尺或射程20/60尺，單一目標。傷害：13（2d6+6）點穿刺傷害，或使用雙手發動近戰攻擊時15（2d8+6）點穿刺傷害。

Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: [[/r 1d20+10]]{+10} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 13 ([[/damage 2d6 + 6 type=piercing]]) damage, or 15 ([[/damage 2d8 + 6 type=piercing]]) damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

水巨靈以魔法射出一道寬5尺，長60尺的線狀水柱。線狀區域內的每個生物必須進行一次DC 16的敏捷豁免。豁免失敗的目標將受到21（6d6）點鈍擊傷害。如果目標爲巨型或更小體型，則該目標從水巨靈所在方向往後推動20尺並應擊倒地。豁免成功的目標所受該鈍擊傷害減半，且不被推後也不會應擊倒地。

The marid magically shoots water in a 60-foot line that is 5 feet wide. Each creature in that line must make a [[/save ability=dex dc=16]] saving throw. On a failure, a target takes 21 ([[/damage 6d6 type=bludgeoning]]) damage and, if it is Huge or smaller, is pushed up to 20 feet away from the marid and knocked &Reference[condition=prone]. On a success, a target takes half the bludgeoning damage, but is neither pushed nor knocked &Reference[condition=prone].

水巨靈可以在空氣和水中呼吸。

The marid can breathe air and water.

水巨靈死亡時，它的身體將分解爲一灘水和泡沫，只留下該水巨靈原先着裝或攜帶的裝備。

If the marid dies, its body disintegrates into a burst of water and foam, leaving behind only equipment the marid was wearing or carrying.

You call forth an elemental servant. Choose an area of air, earth, fire, or water that fills a 10-foot cube within range. An elemental of challenge rating 5 or lower appropriate to the area you chose appears in an unoccupied space within 10 feet of it. For example, a @creature[fire elemental] emerges from a bonfire, and an @creature[earth elemental] rises up from the ground. The elemental disappears when it drops to 0 hit points or when the spell ends.

The elemental is friendly to you and your companions for the duration. Roll initiative for the elemental, which has its own turns. It obeys any verbal commands that you issue to it (no action required by you). If you don't issue any commands to the elemental, it defends itself from hostile creatures but otherwise takes no actions.

If your @status[concentration] is broken, the elemental doesn't disappear. Instead, you lose control of the elemental, it becomes hostile toward you and your companions, and it might attack. An uncontrolled elemental can't be dismissed by you, and it disappears 1 hour after you summoned it.

The DM has the elemental's statistics.

At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, the challenge rating increases by 1 for each slot level above 5th.

materials.value: burning incense for air, soft clay for earth, sulfur and phosphorus for fire, or water and sand for water

description.value:
Until the spell ends, you control any freestanding water inside an area you choose that is a cube up to 100 feet on a side. You can choose from any of the following effects when you cast this spell. As an action on your turn, you can repeat the same effect or choose a different one.

Flood. You cause the water level of all standing water in the area to rise by as much as 20 feet. If the area includes a shore, the flooding water spills over onto dry land.

If you choose an area in a large body of water, you instead create a 20-foot tall wave that travels from one side of the area to the other and then crashes down. Any Huge or smaller vehicles in the wave's path are carried with it to the other side. Any Huge or smaller vehicles struck by the wave have a [[/r 1d100]]{25 percent} chance of capsizing.

The water level remains elevated until the spell ends or you choose a different effect. If this effect produced a wave, the wave repeats on the start of your next turn while the flood effect lasts.

Part Water. You cause water in the area to move apart and create a trench. The trench extends across the spell's area, and the separated water forms a wall to either side. The trench remains until the spell ends or you choose a different effect. The water then slowly fills in the trench over the course of the next round until the normal water level is restored.

Redirect Flow. You cause flowing water in the area to move in a direction you choose, even if the water has to flow over obstacles, up walls, or in other unlikely directions. The water in the area moves as you direct it, but once it moves beyond the spell's area, it resumes its flow based on the terrain conditions. The water continues to move in the direction you chose until the spell ends or you choose a different effect.

Whirlpool. This effect requires a body of water at least 50 feet square and 25 feet deep. You cause a whirlpool to form in the center of the area. The whirlpool forms a vortex that is 5 feet wide at the base, up to 50 feet wide at the top, and 25 feet tall. Any creature or object in the water and within 25 feet of the vortex is pulled 10 feet toward it. A creature can swim away from the vortex by making a Strength (&Reference[skill=Athletics]) check against your spell save DC.

When a creature enters the vortex for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, it must make a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes [[/damage 2d8 type=bludgeoning]] damage and is caught in the vortex until the spell ends. On a successful save, the creature takes half damage, and isn't caught in the vortex. A creature caught in the vortex can use its action to try to swim away from the vortex as described above, but has disadvantage on the Strength (&Reference[skill=Athletics]) check to do so.

The first time each turn that an object enters the vortex, the object takes [[/damage 2d8 type=bludgeoning]] damage; this damage occurs each round it remains in the vortex.

materials.value: a drop of water and a pinch of dust

description.value:
You transform a willing creature you touch, along with everything it's wearing and carrying, into a misty cloud for the duration. The spell ends if the creature drops to 0 hit points. An incorporeal creature isn't affected.

While in this form, the target's only method of movement is a flying speed of 10 feet. The target can enter and occupy the space of another creature. The target has resistance to nonmagical damage, and it has advantage on Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution saving throws. The target can pass through small holes, narrow openings, and even mere cracks, though it treats liquids as though they were solid surfaces. The target can't fall and remains hovering in the air even when &Reference[condition=stunned] or otherwise &Reference[condition=incapacitated].

While in the form of a misty cloud, the target can't talk or manipulate objects, and any objects it was carrying or holding can't be dropped, used, or otherwise interacted with. The target can't attack or cast spells.

materials.value: a bit of gauze and a wisp of smoke

description.value:
A creature you touch becomes &Reference[condition=invisible] until the spell ends. Anything the target is wearing or carrying is &Reference[condition=invisible] as long as it is on the target's person. The spell ends for a target that attacks or casts a spell.

At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, you can target one additional creature for each slot level above 2nd.

effects.name: Invisibility
effects.description: The target becomes Invisible until the spell ends. Anything the target is wearing or carrying is invisible as long as it is on the target's person. The spell ends for a target that attacks or casts a spell.

description.value:
You and up to eight willing creatures who link hands in a circle are transported to a different plane of existence. You can specify a target destination in general terms, such as the City of Brass on the Elemental Plane of Fire or the palace of Dispater on the second level of the Nine Hells, and you appear in or near that destination. If you are trying to reach the City of Brass, for example, you might arrive in its Street of Steel, before its Gate of Ashes, or looking at the city from across the Sea of Fire, at the DM's discretion.

Alternatively, if you know the sigil sequence of a teleportation circle on another plane of existence, this spell can take you to that circle. If the teleportation circle is too small to hold all the creatures you transported, they appear in the closest unoccupied spaces next to the circle.

You can use this spell to banish an unwilling creature to another plane. Choose a creature within your reach and make a melee spell attack against it. On a hit, the creature must make a Charisma saving throw. If the creature fails this save, it is transported to a random location on the plane of existence you specify. A creature so transported must find its own way back to your current plane of existence.

description.value:
This spell grants the ability to move across any liquid surface—such as water, acid, mud, snow, quicksand, or lava—as if it were harmless solid ground (creatures crossing molten lava can still take damage from the heat). Up to ten willing creatures you can see within range gain this ability for the duration.

If you target a creature submerged in a liquid, the spell carries the target to the surface of the liquid at a rate of 60 feet per round.

You either create or destroy water.

Create Water. You create up to 10 gallons of clean water within range in an open container. Alternatively, the water falls as rain in a 30-foot cube within range, extinguishing exposed flames in the area.

Destroy Water. You destroy up to 10 gallons of water in an open container within range. Alternatively, you destroy fog in a 30-foot cube within range.

At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, you create or destroy 10 additional gallons of water, or the size of the cube increases by 5 feet, for each slot level above 1st.

materials.value: a drop of water if creating water or a few grains of sand if destroying it

description.value:
For the duration, you know if there is an aberration, celestial, elemental, fey, fiend, or undead within 30 feet of you, as well as where the creature is located. Similarly, you know if there is a place or object within 30 feet of you that has been magically consecrated or desecrated.

The spell can penetrate most barriers, but it is blocked by 1 foot of stone, 1 inch of common metal, a thin sheet of lead, or 3 feet of wood or dirt.

For the duration, you sense the presence of magic within 30 feet of you. If you sense magic in this way, you can use your action to see a faint aura around any visible creature or object in the area that bears magic, and you learn its school of magic, if any.

The spell can penetrate most barriers, but it is blocked by 1 foot of stone, 1 inch of common metal, a thin sheet of lead, or 3 feet of wood or dirt.

You create a 20-foot-radius sphere of fog centered on a point within range. The sphere spreads around corners, and its area is &Reference[rule=heavilyobscured]{heavily obscured}. It lasts for the duration or until a wind of moderate or greater speed (at least 10 miles per hour) disperses it.

At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the radius of the fog increases by 20 feet for each slot level above 1st.
All nonmagical food and drink within a 5-foot-radius sphere centered on a point of your choice within range is purified and rendered free of poison and disease.
